tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Night is the default theme: matches are played under floodlights.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list groups and the tab bar, sitting on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, search fields, segmented-control tracks and progress-bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. At least 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, helper text, inactive tab labels. On ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Floodlight lime. Fill for the one primary action per screen, the active tab indicator and progress fills. Always carries on-accent content.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, text buttons, active tab label and icon, selected values. On ground, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected chips and the highlighted 'your team' row in tables, behind ink or accent-ink.

tokens.name: confirmed
tokens.usage: Status: confirmed, paid, accepted, booking approved. Teal, deliberately off the red-green axis. As text or icon on ground, surface or confirmed-soft; always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: confirmed-soft
tokens.usage: Background of confirmed status chips and the paid state of a payment row.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Status: awaiting reply, unpaid, booking requested, under the player minimum. As text or icon on ground, surface or pending-soft; always with a word or clock icon.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: Background of pending status chips and the 'needs action' banner.

tokens.name: cancelled
tokens.usage: Status: declined, cancelled, payment failed, destructive actions. As text or icon on ground, surface or cancelled-soft; always with a word or cross icon.

tokens.name: cancelled-soft
tokens.usage: Background of cancelled status chips and the cancelled-match banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status: rescheduled, update, friendly match. As text or icon on ground, surface or info-soft; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info chips and Update notification cards.

tokens.name: ticket
tokens.usage: The Payment Barcode card face. White in both themes so gate scanners read it at full contrast.

tokens.name: ticket-ink
tokens.usage: Barcode bars and all text printed on the ticket face.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard and switch-access focus ring, 2px outside the control. At least 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: scoreboard
styles.usage: Kick-off time on the match hero and the countdown on the ticket. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Fixture headline on match cards and sheet titles.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title: division, pitch, night. Uppercase via text-transform.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and notification titles, section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kick-off 19:40 on Pitch 3. Reply by 07:40 tomorrow.
styles.usage: Default reading text and list-row titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, amounts, list-row titles that need weight.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, segmented controls, form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper and error text, tab-bar labels (12px minimum).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related lines in a card; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large breathing room on the ticket and onboarding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, segmented-control thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list groups, notification cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Match cards, bottom sheets (top corners), the ticket.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, avatars, the progress bar, filter chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Match and notification cards in Day. Night separates with surface against ground instead of shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the floating scan button.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: The Payment Barcode ticket, so it lifts like a physical pass.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height and width for every control (48dp Android, above 44pt iOS).

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Height of full-width primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the home indicator.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Standard icon size in rows, tabs and buttons.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side margin at 375px width; content max width 560px on tablets.
